constraints.name: admin_activities_target_company_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (target_company_id) REFERENCES company(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: admin_activities_target_user_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (target_user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: advertisements_target_catalog_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (target_catalog_id) REFERENCES catalog(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: advertisements_target_company_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (target_company_id) REFERENCES company(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: advertisements_target_product_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (target_product_id) REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

uindexes.name: uq_company_bank_account_default
uindexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_company_bank_account_default ON public.company_bank_accounts USING btree (company_id) WHERE (is_default = true)

constraints.name: company_payouts_bank_account_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (bank_account_id) REFERENCES company_bank_accounts(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

uindexes.name: uq_variant_product_combo_active
uindexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_variant_product_combo_active ON public.product_variants USING btree (product_id, combo_key) WHERE ((deleted_at IS NULL) AND (combo_key IS NOT NULL))

uindexes.name: uq_variant_product_sku_active
uindexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_variant_product_sku_active ON public.product_variants USING btree (product_id, sku) WHERE ((deleted_at IS NULL) AND (sku IS NOT NULL))

constraints.name: rehnicoin_movements_payout_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (payout_id) REFERENCES company_payouts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: report_evidences_report_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (report_id) REFERENCES reports(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: ck_report_target_exclusive
constraints.def: CHECK ((((target_type = 'PRODUCT'::report_target_type) AND (product_id IS NOT NULL) AND (company_id IS NULL)) OR ((target_type = 'COMPANY'::report_target_type) AND (company_id IS NOT NULL) AND (product_id IS NULL))))

uindexes.name: uq_return_active_per_item
uindexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_return_active_per_item ON public.return_requests USING btree (order_item_id) WHERE (status <> 'REJECTED'::return_status)

constraints.name: fk_wallet_transaction_corrects_transaction
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (corrects_transaction_id) REFERENCES wallet_transactions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: wallet_transactions_order_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

uindexes.name: uq_wallet_transaction_refund_per_order
uindexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_wallet_transaction_refund_per_order ON public.wallet_transactions USING btree (order_id) WHERE ((type = 'REFUND'::wallettransactiontype) AND (order_id IS NOT NULL))

uindexes.name: uq_wallet_transaction_correction_per_recharge
uindexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_wallet_transaction_correction_per_recharge ON public.wallet_transactions USING btree (corrects_transaction_id) WHERE (corrects_transaction_id IS NOT NULL)
